purpose: Test the localized study-harness hypothesis that the v1 contact challenge produced zero latent contacts because multichannel_v5 contact_scan events route to organized_action rather than _schedule_contacts.

localized_hypothesis.claim: The v1 challenge's FactorialSimulation._schedule_contacts override was unreachable during normal contact_scan processing because the live multichannel_v5 architecture schedules organized_action events instead of contact events.
localized_hypothesis.repair: Within this synthetic component test only, instantiate the same declared challenge world but set combat.organized_action_architecture=legacy_contact_only so contact_scan reaches _schedule_contacts. Production v5 remains unchanged.
localized_hypothesis.falsifier: If the repaired component test still fails to reach the contact funnel or still produces zero latent contacts under the declared co-located effective focal setup, the routing-only explanation is rejected.

interpretation: Passing identifies the v1 zero-contact result as a study-harness routing failure and restores the contact pathway as testable. It does not validate the production architecture, presence-memory theory, historical fit, or any COIN intervention.
